notes.text: Chronicles names Sheresh. The Babylonian passage names Rava bar Sharshom; Hyman presents the two names in separate notices.
[Heilprin’s Rava bar Sharshom entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3095&lang=en) cites the same encounter before Abaye.
